contentPattern.structure: heading + intro + [Full Name, Country select, Comments] + submit + support/FAQ + success state

suitableFor: simple client-side contact forms with name/country/comments
forms needing an inline success ('Thank You') state and a support contact block
notSuitableFor: forms requiring server-side submission wiring (endpoint out of scope here)
AEM Adaptive Forms / complex multi-step forms

notes: New custom block: no vanilla 'form' template exists in the Block Collection and the forms-excat plugin/skill is not available in this environment. Built from scratch. Submission is client-side only; the source posts to a Broadridge endpoint (form id 3149) which is out of scope for this migration.
